rule: CLAUDE.md migration safety: exact duplicate documentation shares one canonical copy; source-to-canonical alias recorded here. Upstreams are read live (aphrody git upstream read <id> <path>), so verified upstream copies are removed and aliased to the pinned upstream blob.

verification.verified-upstream-copy: git blob SHA-1 of the file (raw, or after CRLF<->LF normalisation) equals a blob of the upstream repository tree at the head recorded in docs/migration/source-map.json (GitHub git/trees API); canonical = upstream:<owner/repo>@<commit>:<path>
verification.stale-generated-copy: older output of scripts/tools/workspace/ecosystem.ts, superseded by docs/ecosystem (read by crates/infra/infra)
verification.empty-stub: no body text besides headings; content remains in git history

kept_unverified_upstream_copies.note: Not byte-identical to the pinned upstream (locally rewritten links) or path not found upstream; kept and listed, not removed.

not_in_catalogue.reason: Bun and Oxc forks were retired and are not in config/upstream-sources.json; upstream-bun is read by crates/compat/bun-docs, crates/compat/n2b-registry and scripts/audit/compat/scripts/n2b/coverage-check.ts
